Name: Builder Assistant 建筑助手
Description: Android-first Builder Assistant. v0.7.0 adds the generic JSON blueprint bridge that will carry future AI-generated buildings. New: a dependency-free strict JSON parser/writer (Core/Json), a blueprint exchange format (BlueprintJson, schemaVersion=1) with serialize/parse/validate round-trip, two-corner live-region COPY (BlueprintCopier) that reads real blocks into a blueprint and auto-exports it, and PASTE that rebuilds a copied or imported blueprint through the SAME BuildPlanner/BuildTask/undo pipeline as the built-in cottage so every safety rule applies identically. Blueprints persist to the Mod's own library under ModsManager.UserDataPath (never a hardcoded device path), which is also the answer to Android local-file access. Fidelity is deliberately conservative: only verified plain-cube vanilla blocks are copied/pasted; stairs, slabs, oriented logs, plants, snow, fluids and entity-bearing blocks are skipped on copy and cause a clear rejection on import/paste instead of a degraded or garbage build. Quarter-turn rotation lives in pure blueprint space. Reserved-but-unsupported fields (per-cell orientation/data/props, top-level buildOps) are rejected loudly, never faked. Undo still only restores cells the player has not since edited. Offline Core+Generators+JSON logic tests now pass 133/133, XDB merge-safety guards 7/7, net472 compiles 0 errors/0 warnings against the real x25.01.17 assemblies; the game-adapter copy/paste/import paths and all Android behavior remain 待验证 (pending real-device verification). v0.6.3 adds clear-soft and a bounded stall. Clear-soft: grass/flowers/tall grass/dead bushes/snow layers and other walk-through blocks the engine flags IsCollidable==false can now be replaced by a build, but only after an explicit extra confirmation tap — never by default; fluids (water/lava), solid terrain and player structures are still refused, and undo restores the exact original plant value. Bounded stall: our own writes can briefly drop a chunk's State below Valid during the engine re-mesh; instead of aborting and rolling back the whole cottage for that transient, the executor pauses in place and retries on the next frame, giving up (with a safe rollback) only after MaxIdleAdvanceCallsDuringBuild consecutive zero-progress calls. v0.6.2 fixed the on-device false '区块未加载' abort: editability now keys on `chunk.State == Valid AND chunk.Cells != null` (never TerrainChunk.IsLoaded) and prints real chunk coordinates. v0.6.1 fixed a shipped database-merge crash from a reused Class-parameter GUID. v0.6 keeps the independent speedboat prototype (behavior unchanged).
